description: This source file defines functions to collect, normalize, render, and write bundled provider authentication environment variables. It includes imports from utility modules and provides CLI reporting functionality.

methods.name: normalizeProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Normalizes provider authentication environment variables into a sorted array of [providerId, envVars] pairs.

methods.name: collectBundledProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Collects and aggregates provider auth env vars from bundled plugin sources into a sorted object.

methods.name: renderBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Generates a TypeScript module string representing the provider auth env vars.

methods.name: writeBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Writes the generated provider auth env vars module to the output path.
